There were a few interesting performances at Warwick Farm's trial morning on Tuesday, where G3 Vain Stakes winner Jimmy Recard sharpened up after nearly a year on the sidelines and a well-bred daughter of Home Affairs stepped out for Mulberry Racing.

The 2026 Keeneland September Yearling Sale is off and racing, and for the first time in 20 years, 18 seven-figure yearlings were sold on the opening day of the 12-day auction. Offspring of supersire Gun Runner accounted for seven of the day's top 12 lots, including a US$2.8 million colt offered by Four Star Sales consignment.
Bred to Win delves into the breeding stories behind the spring’s standout performers, while showcasing an exciting new stallion, a famous racing family and the heritage of Cambridge Stud.

Emmalee and David Browne of Sparta Racing head deeper into spring with an exciting team, led by the last start G2 Let's Elope Stakes winner Pondalowie, while a bunch of new-season 2-year-olds look ready to build towards the future. The duo also have targets around the lucrative Victorian country circuit racing with some of their proven performers.
